title: Curriculum Feedback Survey Form (for Faculty Members) — consolidated

rules.message: Respondents cannot exceed the number of faculty members surveyed.

sections.title: Details of Faculty Member (consolidated)
sections.intro: This is one consolidated report of college-prepared results, not an individual response. Personal fields of the source form (name, email, mobile) are shown as consolidated / not applicable.

fields.label: Number of faculty members who responded
fields.help: Entered as counted; the portal does not calculate percentages.

sections.title: Feedback Survey Form for Faculty member

fields.label: Consolidated average per statement
items: Curriculum is designed as per current industry need and OBE practices.
Curriculum has good balance between theory and practical courses.
The course content fulfils the need of students
Syllabus has made me interested in the subject area
The books prescribed/listed as reference materials are relevant, updated and appropriate.
Freedom to propose, modify, suggest and incorporate new topics in the syllabus.
The course content of the subjects increased my knowledge and perspective
The laboratory experiments enhance understanding of theory concepts and enabled the students to relate with the real life problems.
Institute provides adequate funding, resources and support to faculty members for upgrading their skills and qualifications.

fields.label: On a scale of 1 to 10 how do you rate your overall satisfaction with the prescribed syllabus and the curriculum? (consolidated average)

sections.title: Feedback analysis (workbook instruction 8)
sections.intro: Record what has actually happened. If an item is not yet done, write "Pending" (with the expected date) or "Not applicable" and why.

fields.label: a) Action Taken
fields.guidance: Workbook: mention the actions/initiatives taken based on the survey feedback.

fields.label: b) Impact Analysis
fields.guidance: Workbook: analyse the impact/effectiveness of the actions taken based on the survey feedback.

fields.label: c) Discussion in BoS
fields.guidance: Workbook: key points discussed/reviewed in the Board of Studies (BoS) and the recommendations/decisions taken.

evidence.note: Proposed minimum set (docs/decisions.md D-030), pending college review. Upload BoS minutes once available. Nil submissions need no evidence.
